name: transport-resource-throughput
title: Transported resource throughput
summary: Relay balanced near-MTU resource parts over one warm transported link using each implementation's default TCP policy.
notes: Default-policy deployment view: Prns and RNS retain their normal TCP bitrate and MTU policy.
description: The fixed wire driver establishes one genuine transported link across the relay before measurement, then drives balanced full-duplex LINK/DATA frames in RESOURCE context. Each opaque part fills the negotiated link MTU and carries deterministic sequence data. The relay performs transported-link switching, HDLC framing, buffering, copying, and TCP I/O without endpoint encryption, decryption, resource hashing, or application assembly in the measured window.
conformance: A valid transported link is established before timing; every issued LINK/RESOURCE frame is forwarded once, in order and byte-exact, in both directions, with exact directional payload totals and zero missing, duplicate, corrupt, reordered, unexpected, or timed-out frames.
